svg.title: CyVault — Modular Architecture
svg.text: Kotlin Multiplatform · Android + iOS · Compose Multiplatform · Koin · Ktor · Navigation Compose · Microsoft Entra External ID (MSAL)
App.kt root NavHost · Koin appModules · CyVaultApp iOS framework
one flow · layers at the module root
feature:vault · one package per screen, each with its own layers and Koin module, plus a shared card/ package
SessionManager interface · no Compose, no routes
app loads core's platform + network Koin modules
Dependency rules · a module only sees what its build.gradle.kts declares
✓ app → authentication, vault, core (the only composition root: NavHost, Koin modules, iOS framework)
✕ authentication ↔ vault: never import each other; app connects them with navigation callbacks
✕ vault's screen packages never import each other; only navigation/ puts them together
popUpTo removes the previous root screen, so Back can't return to
login after signing in, or to the vault after signing out.
vault signs the user out without importing authentication.
Koin injects SessionManagerImpl into VaultHomeViewModel; on success the
NavigateToLogin effect calls app's callback, which goes back to AuthRoute.
iOS not migrated to Entra yet
Yapily and the card API use core's shared Ktor HttpClient; dashed = still on AWS.
